Check a host's setup, and with --fix fix what it can

## Synopsis

Checks a host: systemd and linger, the restore unit, terminfo, memory caps and the
agents. With --fix it offers to fix linger, the restore unit, Ghostty's terminfo, a
broken current helper link, stale session sockets and old helper versions. Each fix
is shown and explained before it runs; one that needs root is printed for you.

```text
simstim host doctor <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```text
      --fix    offer to fix the problems found, one by one
  -h, --help   help for doctor
      --json   print JSON
  -y, --yes    with --fix, apply every fix without asking
```
